## Finding new places: the backlog check (Sean, 2026-10-10)

"Can the scan also look for new Vegan restaurants as well?" then "Go, start with the backlog". About 2,970 listings sat
quarantined since the May and June imports, never reviewed: 2,386 from our `ve_businesses` list (Instagram handles, no
address, many of them people and creators), 441 from the spreadsheet (244 with a city or "South Florida", 174 a name only),
129 from the SoFlo Vegans Facebook group (city and website), and a few others. `ve-discover` sorts them; nothing is listed
until someone decides (migration `20261010_ve_backlog_checks.sql`, table `ve_backlog_checks`, one row per listing).

- Tracks: **google** (a place: looked up on Google Places by name, kept only in the same state and, when we know which of our
  cities it is in, the same city area), **ig** (only a handle: read with Apify's Instagram profile scraper; a food business
  with one of our cities in its bio or post locations then goes to Google too), **thin** (a name only: nothing to check).
- Matching rules learned on the first batches: one name inside the other, or most real words shared with at least two of them
  (one shared word matched "Green Bar and Kitchen" to "Living Green Cafe"); our state only (Inca Chicken, Hollywood FL, matched
  Maryland); our city area only (South Florida's "Third Culture" matched Titusville); a renamed place ("Meraki Juice Kitchen is
  NOW Christopher's Kitchen") is a duplicate of the listing it became. Instagram leaves the business flag off for many
  restaurants, so a category or food words count as a business; creator categories (artist, writer, musician...) are people.
- Verdicts: **Ready to list** (open, and Vegan by Google's Vegan restaurant category or the business's own name or Instagram
  bio; Google's description saying "Vegan options" is only a Check), **Check**, **Not a restaurant**, **Closed** (Google, or an
  Instagram quiet for over a year with no Google profile), **Already listed**, **Not found**, **A person**, **Not enough to check**.
- Runs by cron `ve-discover-backlog` (every 2 minutes, 40 Instagram accounts and 25 Google lookups a run); with nothing
  pending it costs nothing. Keep it on: Directory review's Paste a list feeds it (the import backlog finished 2026-10-27).
- **Depot > Business outreach > New places** (`#places/<verdict>[/<city>]`, `#place/<listing>`, a card on the home): each
  verdict a tab with its count, by city; one business opens with what Google and Instagram said, links, and its website framed.
  **Add to the Directory** needs a category and how Vegan it is (100% Vegan, Vegan options, Vegan friendly), picked on purpose,
  and fills Google's address, place id, phone and website (`backlog_decide`). Since 2026-10-27 (Sean: "they're a rescue and they're
  a nonprofit... I should be able to add multiple categories... and to manipulate the logo with the new logo feature") the screen
  has the **logo editor** (`VELogoEditor`, with up to four pictures from their website, `add_site`; saved after the listing through
  `add_logo_url` and `logo_set`, so it shows in Logos > Done) and **Main category** plus **Also show it under** (any others,
  saved as `extra_categories` through `ve-claims` `admin_listing`); How Vegan hides only when every section ticked is Rescues,
  Sanctuaries, Nonprofits or Events; **Add the ticked** (Sean, 2026-10-27: "Build the Add all ticked button"): Ready to list has a tick box on every row
  and its own Add as (the category from the guess, `guessCatOf`; How Vegan for anything but an organization), and one button that
  adds every ticked row through `backlog_decide`, on whichever city tab is open. Organizations start ticked; a food place starts
  unticked until its How Vegan is picked (never guessed), and the button waits until every ticked row is complete. The logo and
  other sections are left to the place's own page (the logo sweep suggests a logo afterwards); a place's own page and Directory review's What it
  shows both have a **Name** field (Sean, 2026-10-27: "I wanted to change the title and I couldn't"), saved through `ve-claims`
  `admin_listing` like the listing editor; **Set aside** makes it `rejected` with a note,
  never deleted. Closed, Not found, A person, Not enough to check and Already listed have **Set these aside** for the page. A
  newly listed business joins its city's outreach through Find emails on the city card.
- **Ready to list, sorted by Logan** (Sean, 2026-10-27: "take a good estimated guess... populate it... once I see it up and running, I
  can go ahead and make adjustments"; migration `20261027_ready_to_list_bulk.sql`, run through a one-time function because the
  connector held it): 242 listed with a best-guess category and How Vegan and a note saying so, 19 set aside with why (duplicates,
  one closed, MorningStar Farms as vegetarian, American Humane and RSPCA for their farm labels), 11 left for Sean (no location to
  go by, or Google matched the wrong business). A listing with no address reads as online and shows in every chapter, so a local
  group known only by its chapter gets its state as well as `communities`.
- Next (approved by Sean the same day): the monthly search for new places in each city, after the check-ups.
- **The restaurant search for the newer chapters** (Sean, 2026-10-28: "Philadelphia doesn't have any restaurants, and neither does
  London... West Virginia, Maryland, Delaware, Washington, D.C., and North Florida... do a scan of those areas and start populating
  them"; Virginia had none either; migration `20261028_restaurant_search_new_chapters.sql`). 59 Google Places text searches ("vegan
  restaurant / cafe / bakery in <city or neighborhood>") listed 359 places live (`crawl_source` `restaurant-search`, Google place, address
  and map pin, a team note): **100% Vegan** when Google's main type is Vegan restaurant or the name says Vegan (not Vegetarian or -ish),
  public at once; **Vegan options** when Google tags it Vegan or Vegetarian as a second type, so it waits in Being vetted for 10 member
  votes. Bakeries and cafes by Google's type, caterers to Catering, the rest Restaurants; stores and places with no Vegan label left out;
  two branches with one name in one city get their neighborhood (or street) after a dash. By chapter: London 97, Virginia 64,
  Philadelphia 61, Maryland 54, Florida (the North Florida searches) 43, Washington, D.C. 18, Delaware 16, West Virginia 6. The logo
  sweep, the menu link finder and reader, and the essentials pass fill them in; the essentials cron was widened the same day to every 10
  minutes, 6 to 10 AM UTC, 30 a run (it costs nothing once nothing is due). A listing outside the US shows no empty state in its address
  (`directory/listing.html`). Run it again for a new chapter the same way: searches, then the same rules. **Atlanta and Los Angeles** got the same search the same day (Sean: "run the restaurant search for Atlanta and Los
  Angeles"; migration `20261028_restaurant_search_atlanta_los_angeles.sql`): 194 live, Atlanta 64 and Los Angeles 130. The Los Angeles
  chapter matched only five city names, so its list was widened to the cities found (Pasadena, Long Beach, Santa Monica, Burbank,
  Glendale, Culver City...; `LA` in `ve-hubs.js`, `LA_CITIES` in `directory/listing.html`, `HUBS` in `ve-claims`, `ve_outreach_cities`). **New York and Central
  Florida** the same day (migration `20261028_restaurant_search_new_york_central_florida.sql`): 191 live, New York 105 (a borough with no
  city of its own takes the borough, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island) and Central Florida 86 (13 nearby cities joined `CF`, and
  `CFL_CITIES` in `directory/listing.html` is now the whole list). **South Florida** the same day (migration
  `20261028_restaurant_search_south_florida.sql`): 101 live (18 100% Vegan, 83 Vegan options; most of its Vegan places were listed
  already), and Naranja, North Bay Village, Opa-locka, Tavernier and Stock Island joined `SF` (the county slices in `SF_COUNTIES` moved
  with them; `SF_CITIES` in `directory/listing.html` is now the whole list). It took the Directory past 1,000 approved listings, which
  showed that `fetchAll` in `ve-region-directory.js` had never paged: its second request asked for the first page again, forever, and
  every Directory view stayed empty for about 30 minutes until it was fixed (`(offset || 0) + 1000`, `order=id`). The Directory reads
  1,000 listings a request and pages until a short page.
  **London and Philadelphia, a second pass** the same day (Sean: "run the restaurant search for London and Philadelphia again... make
  sure that there's something in each listing"; migration `20261028_restaurant_search_london_philadelphia_2.sql`): 88 searches by
  neighborhood (and Pennsylvania's other cities, since the chapter is the whole state), 102 live, London 62 and Philadelphia 40. The
  field mask now asks for `regularOpeningHours`, so hours are saved at insert from Google's opening periods (never from its display
  text, which writes "12:00 to 11:00 PM" for noon), and a name we set aside never comes back. **Every new listing has something in
  it** (Sean: "when people click in it, that they're actually getting something... hours... basic information, and a menu"): hours
  and phone from Google at insert, the About line and kinds of food from **`ve-listing-about`** (below), and a Menu tab: their menu
  link when the link finder found one, else their own website (a food place with no menu link; `menuLinkOut` in
  `directory/listing.html`, "opens their website, where they post their menu").
- **The About reader** (Sean, 2026-10-28; edge function `ve-listing-about`, migration `20261028_ve_listing_about.sql`). The Background
  writer's `listing_essentials` pass had fallen 850 behind, so new listings showed no About. This does that job on the server: it reads
  the business's home and about pages, asks Google Places for the place's own summary and what it serves, and Claude (Opus 5.5,
  structured output) writes one or two plain sentences (130 to 240 characters, Vegan capitalized, no dashes, never upgrading how Vegan
  our listing says it is) and one to four cuisines, saved through `ve_listing_essentials_save` (only empty fields, never over an owner's
  words, a `ve_listing_edits` row each). A site that cannot be read gets a line from Google and our listing only, said so in its note.
  Queue: `ve_listing_about_due()` (ve_listing_essentials rows still queued, restaurant-search listings first); cron `ve-listing-about`,
  12 every 2 minutes. `one` (`slug`, `save: false` to preview) for a single listing. Its notes flag a How Vegan that disagrees with
  their own site (Sweet Love: "many Vegan options", listed 100% Vegan).

## Guide pricing, points and levels (LOCKED by Sean 2026-10-25, playbook `ve-pricing-points-passport`)

Concept session with V, locked by Sean: "lock it". This replaces Guide credits (canon `canon-ve-guide-pricing` v3, 2026-10-10).

- **$11 is the price of admission.** Any purchase of $11 or more makes the buyer a member: the Passport, a Guide, an event
  ticket or merchandise (`ve_member_admit`: `active`, `entry_paid_at`). After joining, members buy only what they want.
- **The Passport is $11 one time** (the Founding Membership, `ve-entry-checkout`) and comes with **1,100 welcome points**
  (`ve-stripe-webhook` `entry_contribution`, `ve_points_grant(member, 1100, 'welcome', 'welcome')`, once per member). Other ways
  in (a Guide, a ticket) give membership and the purchase, no welcome points. No monthly Passport is offered.
- **Founding Members close at midnight Eastern on January 1, 2027, and no more comps** (Sean, 2026-11-01: "I'm not going to comp
  anybody... your chance of becoming a founding member expires at midnight on January 1st... that's a thing that sits on your profile";
  migration `20261101_founding_member_deadline.sql`, playbook `ve-pricing-points-passport`). Anyone whose `entry_paid_at` is first set
  before `ve_founding_deadline()` (`ve_site_settings` `founding_member`, 2027-01-01T05:00Z) gets `founding_member` (trigger
  `trg_ve_founding_on_paid`; Guide accounts never); until that day only invitations set it, so paying members were unmarked (backfilled).
  Comps already given stay. **Built and live the same day** (migration `20261101_founding_words_no_comps.sql`; `ve-dashboard` v17 and
  `ve-invites` from commit 297fd8b, source sha256 matched):
  - **Give points** on the dashboard's member card (super admins): quick picks 111, 500, 1,100, 2,500, 5,000, an amount and why, a
    confirm, the last 10 gifts listed (`ve-dashboard` `give_points`: 1 to 100,000, `ve_points_grant` reason `admin_adjust`, ref
    `founder:<uuid>:<note>`, refused for super admins and Guide accounts; `member_card` `gifts`).
  - **Find a member** (Recent activity, first line, super admins): name, username or email, up to 20, an exact email first, Guide and
    quarantined accounts left out (`ve-dashboard` `member_search`); a pick opens their card. `wireFindMember` in center-console.
  - **The line**, "Founding Membership closes at midnight Eastern on January 1, 2027. Join before then and Founding Member stays on your
    profile for good.", on the Passport Guide (Overview and Get your Passport, `FOUNDING_LINE`), the $11 window (`VE_FOUNDING_OPEN` in
    `ve-auth.js`; after the deadline its title and button read Passport), `/policies#membership` (Founding Members), the Guides' facts
    and the saved answer When can I become a Founding Member? (What is a Founding Member? reworded; the two answers about a membership
    on us retired), the nav announcement, the dashboard welcome for non-members, the Founding Member and Ambassador invitation emails,
    their follow-ups and `/invite`, and Depot > Founding Members. Every one of them drops the line by itself after the deadline.
  - **The member's own dashboard reads `founding_member`**: the eyebrow says Founding Member, the plan Founding Member Passport and the
    welcome "Thank you for being a Founding Member." only when it is set; any other active member reads Member, Passport and "Thank you
    for being a member." (`ve-dashboard` `home` returns `founding_member` and `member_id`; `dashApplyFounding`).
  - **No comps in the Depot**: On us is gone from Invites (its plain kind is now An invitation to join, at $11), Founding Members and
    Ambassadors, and `ve-invites` `create` makes every founding, ambassador and plain invitation `comp` false while `founding_member.comps`
    is false (`compsAllowed`). Nonprofit and Group Partner leads keep the membership their locked canon gives; dinner seats and the
    Community Manager role keep their own choice for now (Sean's call).
  - **An Ambassador invitation without a comp** (Logan's default, Sean's to change): someone who has not paid says yes (`accepted`), pays
    the $11 on `/invite`, and on payment (`ve_founding_invite_paid`, through `universe_invite_claim`) becomes an Ambassador with the
    level, profile and the points Sean set (reason `admin_adjust`, ref `invite:<id>`, on top of the Passport's 1,100); a member who
    already paid becomes one at once. Founding Member comes only from paying before the deadline, never from an invitation. Proven
    2026-11-01 in a rolled-back transaction.
  - Still to do: Dani's recorded line on the Ambassador Guide's Your membership tab says the membership is on us (true for the comps
    already given, not for a paid Ambassador): new words and a new recording need Sean.
- **Every Guide is $11 or 1,100 points**, yours to keep (`ve_guides.access_rule = 'points'`, `cost_lesars` 1100;
  `ve-guide-unlock` `checkout` for $11, `unlock` for points; `ve_guide_purchase_paid` admits the buyer). Free Guides (the Welcome
  Guide, the Partner Guide) stay open to everyone.
- **Submitting or claiming a listing is $11 or 1,100 points, each one** (Sean, 2026-10-27, on claims: "it's like a guide or any
  other thing... If they come in as a business wanting to claim their listing, that's what their 1100 points is used for... they
  can ultimately decide not to use it for that thing and use it for something else"; `ve-claims` `start` takes `pay: 'points'` the
  same way, and Join the Directory shows Use your points on a claim too. However someone comes in, the $11 is what the 1,100
  points are for: the thing they came for, or anything else points buy. Sean, 2026-10-27, on listings: "you get 1100 points when you register. So you
  could use that for submitting your listing... if you want to submit multiple listings... 1100 points each time... or you can just
  pay for the listing"). Join the Directory's How to join, when adding a business, has **Use your points** beside the Partner plan and
  the $11 (the live balance from `ve-auth` `me`); `ve-claims` `listing_apply` `pay: 'points'` saves the application, then
  `ve_listing_submit_points(member, claim)` takes 1,100 from both balances once per application (`points_ledger` reason
  `listing_submit`, ref `claim:<id>`; migration `20261027_ve_listing_submit_points.sql`), and it waits in Depot > Claims like any
  application. The policy (`/policies#membership`), the Guides' facts and a saved answer say the same.
- **Super admins see every paid Guide unlocked** (Sean, 2026-10-30: "if I want to see how it looks otherwise, I can change my view"): `ve-guide-unlock` `access()` returns `via` `admin`; a View As preview sends no token, so The public or Member shows it locked.
- **Every purchase earns a flat 25-point thank-you** (`ve_purchase_thanks(member, ref)`, reason `purchase_thanks`, once per
  ref: `stripe:<session>`, `guide:<id>`, `tour:<order>`).
- **Points are given, never bought.** They come from taking part: Bounties, competitions and campaigns, the Daily Pulse, the
  Community Board, referrals. They unlock Guides, pay for Guide chat (4 a message) and can be **given to a business or
  nonprofit as a boost, never money** (`ve-votes` `contribute`, `ve_listing_contribute`, 1 to 10,000; the listing's total is
  `ve-votes` `points`, `ve_listing_points`; the Give box on every listing page).
- **Levels 1 to 4 on lifetime points** (`member_points.total_points`, which never goes down): Level 2 from 2,500, Level 3 from
  10,000, Level 4 from 25,000 (`ve_affiliate_levels.min_lifetime`, read by `ve_member_level`; the dashboard's `VE_LEVEL_AT`; change
  both together). Spending or giving points never lowers a level. Sean confirmed 2,500 and 10,000 on 2026-10-25; Level 4 came with
  the affiliate ladder (below), its 25,000 a default Logan set. A level the team sets (`members.level_override`) is the least they have.
- **Levels are the affiliate ladder** (Sean, 2026-10-28: "level one, with your link, you get points and allows you to level up
  quicker to level two, where you can start getting commissions... 20%... level three... 25%... level four... 30%, and we max out at
  30%... when they get level three... the guides now become open... route their commissions to a nonprofit of their choosing... So they
  get the credit for the donation"; migration `20261028_affiliate_levels.sql`, run through `ve-once-affiliate`, now the 410 stub). Every
  member's link is `/passport?ref=<referral_code>`. Level 1: 111 points when a friend becomes a member. **Level 2 gets the commission instead when the friend pays, but still the 111 points when the friend joins free by the survey door; Level 3 and up get both** (Sean, 2026-11-03: "they should get the 111 points if that person completes the survey"; `ve_referral_on_admit`, proven 2026-11-03 in a rolled-back transaction: a Level 2 sponsor got 111 points on a survey join and none extra on a paid join). Level 2: 20% of the Passport
  bought through the link; Level 3: 25%, and Guides bought with money too; Level 4: 30%, the top (`ve_affiliate_levels`: `rate_pct`,
  `products`, one row a level; change a rate or what a level opens there). Defaults Logan set, Sean's to change: the commission is a
  share of the $11 price (`sale_cents`), never of anything given on top; it counts for purchases by someone who joined with the link
  within 12 months of joining (`window_days`), at the referrer's level on the day; it waits 30 days for refunds (`hold_days`), then
  turns Ready (cron `ve-affiliate-release`, daily); it is paid once $25 is ready (`min_payout_cents`) and after a W-9 (the finance
  module's `finance_payees`, `finance_request_payout`, `finance_1099_list`); never on your own purchases or for a Guide account (all in

## Earn your Passport (LOCKED by Sean 2026-11-01, playbook `ve-pricing-points-passport`)

Concept session with V, locked by Sean: "lock it" (canon `canon-ve-earn-your-passport`; migration
`20261101_earn_your_passport_canon.sql`). **Parts 1 to 4 are built and live (below); 5 to 7 are not.** Sean: "people can earn their membership... not for what they did in the past,
but for what you're doing right now"; "I actually would prefer people to do that than pay the $11." Browsing stays free, taking part stays
the $11 Passport or a membership earned now; no free account that can take part, and comps stay ended (the Depot cannot give memberships).

- **The Taster account**: a name and email make it. It opens only the sampler Guide, their challenges, check-ins while a challenge runs and
  their own link; the rest of the site as signed out (no votes, posts, saves or points to spend). Finishing a challenge or paying the $11
  turns the same account into a membership. A Taster is "on the list", never a member.
- **The sampler, A Taste of Vegans Explore**: every Guide's free piece (B12, the Buttermilk swap, Hard Rock Stadium, FLL, tip 1, the free
  restaurant check) and what Vegans Explore is, the whole cast narrating, the For the animals side included; each page ends with "the rest
  of this Guide comes with your Passport". Three sign-up questions (what brings you, your city, your Vegan journey) pick the suggested Guide
  and chapter news. The Welcome Guide stays public.
- **Three challenges** (pick 1 to 3, Start, 30 days, one restart; every task proven like a bounty and approved): **Support Local** (3
  check-ins at Vegan places, one action each, I bought something at least once; in a stops month, 3 of the month's stops), **The Connector**
  (3 people join with the $11 through your link), **The Advocate** (a free event on the guest pass, a sanctuary or rescue visit or
  volunteering, a Fosters or Rescues share). Each is worth 1,100 points: one challenge pays the Passport; all three are a membership, 2,200
  points on top and Level 2 by lifetime points. A profile badge (working name Trailblazer).
- **The new check-in, for everyone**: after I'm here, What are you doing here today?: What I ordered (a photo, upload only while checked in),
  I bought something (a receipt, card number covered), Post it (an Instagram or TikTok link tagging the place and @vegansexplore), a
  shout-out (a positive prompt, read by a person first), and the bounties open there. Photos also reach the restaurant. Owners and staff earn
  nothing at their own place. Starting points (Sean's to change): check-in 10, meal photo 15, receipt 25, post 25, shout-out 10, capped per
  place per day.
- **Monthly Passport Challenge stops**: up to five featured businesses per chapter a month plus one free community stop (a sanctuary, rescue
  or nonprofit event). Slots open about six weeks ahead, locked by the 10th of the month before, no back-to-back when there is a waitlist,
  live on the 1st; the first check-in of the month pays the most. Pilot South Florida.
- **The business offer**: four $25 digital gift cards for a slot, a Promotion in the Vegan Restaurant Guide and on `/business` (five slots,
  the deadline, the ask, why, their card as it will look). It gives membership (Founding before January 1, 2027, paid in value) and covers
  the claim. The form is the agreement: promotional, $25 off, one per visit, no cash back, expiring 12 months after won, removed if the
  business closes, Florida law (the lawyer reads it once before the pilot). A two-day follow-up on the business's tracked link (not opened,
  opened not chosen, chosen), from the team, leftovers to the Inbox.
- **Cards and the Vault**: the card lives in the member's dashboard (logo, $25, their name, a code, expiry); staff redeem by typing the
  restaurant's short PIN on the member's phone, one use, the PIN changed when staff leave; owners see counts only. **The Vault is un-tabled**
  (it was tabled 2026-10-31 in BrandDesk): members bid points for a week, one win a month, only the winner pays; a public Vault page shows
  every prize by city, bidding for members; unwon cards stay up until won or expired.
- **The content gig** a month ahead per stop: a 15 to 30 second vertical owner clip and someone eating, cut into a reel, from an example page.
- **Points rule change**: a business may spend the points it has received on our services (Partner plan, BrandDesk, the shop, a Diplomat
  membership) at 1 cent a point, up to half the price, never cashed out ($25 off is 2,500 points). Replaces "a boost, never money".
- **Not-ready-yet emails** for Tasters: Day 0, 3, 7, 14, then the weekly Daily Pulse for their chapter; three December notes on the Founding
  deadline; at most one a week otherwise; London consent box; paying ends the track. Reuse the outreach people-list engine.

## The event host path (LOCKED by Sean 2026-11-02, playbook `ve-event-host-path`)

Locked with Logan's panel answers (Sean: "lock it and then deploy"; canon `canon-ve-event-host-path`; migration
`20261102_event_host_path_canon.sql`; write-up `docs/proposals/event-host-path.md`). **Step 1 is built (below); the rest is not.** Sean: "every time we bring a
new event in, we're building our directory in other places... are you running this event? Click here... do you want to do an event
with us?... it's per event." Separate from Group Partners.

- **Every approved event's page** (server-rendered, `api/event.js`) links its people, venue and group, and offers **Are you running
  this event?** into the Vegan Events Guide and a claim.
- **Paid events: 5% a ticket**, no flat fee, the same for everyone. Card processing is on the buyer, and the host may pass the 5% on.
  Member hosts get no lower rate. A ticket of $11 or more makes the buyer a member.
- **Free events are a Vegans Explore sponsorship**:
  - **They give:** "Sponsored by Vegans Explore" on their flyer and page, RSVPs through our page, a stage mention, our QR cards,
    tags on their posts.
  - **We give:** a featured calendar spot, a Daily Pulse mention, a story, the weekly roundup, door check-in, a recap, sponsor prices.
  - Events of 200 or more apply for the Events Guide's full sponsorship.
- **Extras** (the sponsor price is 30% off):

  | Extra | Price |
  |---|---|
  | Pulse feature | $50 |
  | Pinned on the calendar, 2 weeks | $50 |
  | Social push | $75 |
  | Share bounty | $75 |
  | Chapter ad slots, 2 weeks | $100 |
  | A creator at the event | $150 |
  | Recap reel | $150 |
  | Press release | $500 |

  Packages: Spotlight $149, Boost $279, Front Row $499. Each is checked against delivery cost before it opens.
- **$50 in ad credit**, once per host, on claiming their event: our slots only, 90 days, no cash value. It comes with **creative
  support**: we make the ad from what they send, they approve it, one round of changes. Every ad on our pages is made or approved by
  our team, paid ones too.
- **The heads-up email**:
  - **From:** the team, signed by the chapter's Community Manager, never Sean's name.
  - **How often:** at most one every 14 days per host, events grouped.
  - **To whom:** published emails only; in London, business addresses only.
  - **What it says:** no prices.
  - Sean approves the template once; after that it goes out on its own through the outreach people-list engine.
- **Step 1, the event claim, built and live 2026-11-02** (Sean: "start step 1"; migration `20261102_event_claims.sql`, applied
  through the one-time `ve-once-event-claims`, now the 410 stub; `ve-events` from commit 4ec511b, source sha256 matched). Every live
  event's page has **Are you running this event?** under the RSVP box (Your claim is in / approved once they have sent one), opening
  `#claim/<id>` (`drawClaim` in `public/ve-events.js`): their part (I'm hosting it, I'm promoting it, It's at my venue), name, email,
  their group or venue (the name guests see), phone, a link that shows it is theirs (else a note), Send my claim; then a thank-you
  with the Vegan Events Guide. Open to anyone (a host is often not a member). `ve-events` `claim` (public): `ve_event_claims` (RLS on,
  no policies), 3 a day per email, one open claim per event and email, the signed-in account kept only when the claim is in its own
  email; an email to the chapter's active Community Managers (else the team) and a confirmation to them from the team; a [TEST] name
  sends nothing. It is in the Inbox (source `event_claim`). **Depot > Events > Claims** (`#claims/new|approved|declined`,
  `#claim/<id>`): who, their part, their link, whether an account has their email; **Approve** or **Decline** (a note needed, which they
  get). Approving makes them the event's organizer (`ve_event_organizers`, the name guests see, Guests and messages) through
  `ve_event_claim_link`, at once when an account has their email, else when one is made (`trg_ve_event_claim_link` on `members`), and
  emails them their page, Promote your event, and tickets and the sponsorship as coming soon. Proven 2026-11-02 against the live
  function: bad email, role and proof refused, a repeat recognized, a visitor refused the admin actions, a decline without a note
  refused, an approval linking the internal test account, a second approval refused, an approval with no account linking once the
  account appeared (in a rolled-back transaction), the page at 1366 and 390 px with no errors; every test row removed. Not yet: a host
  with no account cannot make one without the $11 (sign-up is the Passport), so the email asks them to reply and the team helps; the
  $50 ad credit on claim waits for step 5.
- **Step 2, the heads-up email, built 2026-11-02, waiting for Sean's approval** (Sean: "Build the list and template on the outreach
  people-list engine... Nothing sends until I approve it once"; migration `20261102_event_heads_up.sql`; edge function `ve-event-headsup`

## Door Guides (LOCKED by Sean 2026-11-02, playbook `ve-door-guides`)

Concept session with V, locked by Sean: "lock it", with the panel's seven changes (canon `canon-ve-door-guides`; migration
`20261102_door_guides_canon.sql`; write-up `docs/proposals/door-guides.md`). **Step 1 built and live 2026-11-03 (below); the rest is not built.** Sean: "turn these... into free guides... all they got to do is give us their email address to unlock it... We
don't scare them away by saying it's $11."
**Canon v3 (Sean, 2026-11-03): one membership, two doors.** The survey door and the $11 Passport are the same membership: the same
access to everything a member can do (the whole door Guide, recording clips for the podcast, claiming, sponsorship, saving across devices).
The only differences are the points (1,100 with the $11; the survey pays its own) and a few perks the $11 has. The "Three levels" below are
v1 history: the email-only reader level is retired (step 2 replaced it), and the $11 does not alone unlock recording.

- **Which**: the Vegan Events Guide first, then the Creator, Nonprofit and Vegan Restaurant Guides. Topic Guides (Dairy, Nutrition,
  Airport, Stadium & Arena...) stay $11 or 1,100 points. On 2026-11-02 nobody had paid for the four door Guides (only Sean's comps).
- **Three levels**: open (the Overview and the free example, indexed); **free with an email** (the rest to read; asked inside the Guide
  when they open a second section, one field, confirmed by the emailed link, making them a Taster with a welcome series for that Guide);
  **a member, by either door, their voice** (v3: not the $11 alone; record in the browser the question of the month, their story, good news, what they are struggling
  with; approved clips become podcast segments, one per Guide, Host Notes for events, credited on their People profile, points once

## Pre-Vegan Certification (LOCKED by Sean 2026-11-05, playbook `vegans-explore-initiative-business-certification`)

Canon `canon-ve-pre-vegan-certification` (v2). **Nothing built, sent or charged.** Vegan-food verification, pass or fail, for named dishes and
the kitchen practice behind them at one location, never "this restaurant is Vegan"; the lane for restaurants with Vegan options (100% Vegan
restaurants stay in the Restaurant Guide lane). The standard to work from is the playbook record **STANDARD V1.2** (2026-11-05, locked by Sean
from the Legal Research Report V1 he uploaded, AI-assisted research, not an attorney opinion): gates G1 to G8 all must pass; one public standard,
no public levels and no Shared Equipment mark; every certified dish has a protected cooking path (a clean separate pan, pot or barrier counts;
never shared fryer oil, cooking water or an uncleaned grill with animal products); a change to a dish stops its mark at once; suspension does not
wait on intent; every critical staff question right; public registry with a live QR status page, never a failure log; records for the term plus 5
years; the fee never buys the outcome; the pilot cohort (5 to 10, South Florida) is free and the price is set after the first two audits are
timed; verifier, desk reviewer and approver are different people and the approver is a person. Stamp: "Plant-Based Dish, Pre-Vegan Certified",
with N of M menu items certified and what else the restaurant serves. **Entity**: Sean is dissolving Vegans Explore Inc. (the nonprofit, never
501(c)(3)) from 2026-11-05; Vegans Explore continues as a DBA of LESARUSS Inc. (a separate LLC is open, decided before paid applications), and the
Vegans Explore Stripe account, bank account and recurring billing must move to LESARUSS Inc. first. **Verifiers** are recruited by a job posting
to our network (experienced people), not hired until the pilot. **Done is a recipe**: each finished step gets a dated record of what, how, who and
where, so the playbook shows how to run the program again. **Work it from the playbook's A-to-Z WORK QUEUE record** (A Foundation, B Build, C Pilot,
D Launch, Parked; GATE steps block what follows); anything not in the queue is a new idea for Sean, never built quietly. The Pre-Vegan
Restaurant Guide copies `guides/vegan-restaurant-guide.html` (template gate).

## Pre-Vegan Certification: B4, the dish registry and the QR status page (Logan, 2026-11-06, playbook `vegans-explore-initiative-business-certification`)

Built from Standard V1.2 (playbook record 044b9cf2). The standard, the queue and B1 to B3 live on branches `claude/fervent-hamilton-fc48qo` and
`claude/inspiring-hypatia-ilwro1` (not on `main`); this is on `claude/gracious-gauss-d7r3h7` (not on `main`). **Nothing is certified, sent or launched.**

- **Data** (migration `20261106_pre_vegan_dish_registry.sql`, applied through the one-time `ve-once-preveg-registry`, now the 410 stub, since the
  connector held it): `ve_preveg_certs` (one location for one 12-month term: `listing_id`, the QR `code` (7 characters, no 0, O, 1, I or L),
  `term_start`, `term_end`, `menu_items_total` (the M in N of M), `also_serves` (meat, fish, dairy, eggs), `verifier_name`, `desk_reviewer_name`
  (must differ), `team_note`), `ve_preveg_dishes` (`status` applied, pending, active, suspended, expired, revoked, withdrawn; `certified_at`) and
  `ve_preveg_dish_events` (every move with its reason and who). RLS on, no policies. **Records are kept**: a delete on any of the three, or an edit to
  the history, raises `records_are_kept` (G8, term plus 5 years); a direct status update raises `use_ve_preveg_dish_set_status`.
- **Moves** (`ve_preveg_dish_set_status(dish, to, reason, actor)`, service role only): applied to pending or withdrawn; pending to active (the approver),
  applied (did not pass, re-test) or withdrawn; active to suspended, expired, revoked or withdrawn; suspended to active, expired, revoked or withdrawn;
  expired to applied (renewal); revoked and withdrawn are final. A reason is always required; only a super admin moves; **active needs** a current
  term, the menu count, both people named, and an approver who is neither of them (by member id or name). **No grace period**: cron
  `ve-preveg-expire` (05:05 UTC) and every team read expire dishes whose term ended, and the public read treats an ended term as not current at once.
- **Public** (`ve_preveg_cert_public(code)`, `ve_preveg_registry_public()`): only active and suspended dishes in a current term, N of M, what else
  they serve, the term; never a reason, never applied or pending, never the people or the note. States: certified, suspended (none active), not_current
  (once certified, nothing now, no detail), not_found (never certified). Never a failure log.
- **Edge function `ve-certification`** (verify_jwt off): public `status {code}`, `registry` (no-store, so a suspension shows at once); team (a super
  admin's token, or the admin token with `as_member`; a Guide account is view only) `list`, `get`, `listing_find`, `cert_save`, `dish_add`,
  `dish_edit` (a certified dish keeps its name: a changed dish is a new review), `dish_status`. Deployed from bdd8538, source sha256 matched.
- **Depot > Pre-Vegan Certification** (`/admin/depot/certification`, Directory in the Go to menu; copied from the Watchlist): certificates by
  Certified, Has a suspension, In progress, Not current; New certificate (find the Directory listing); one certificate (`#c/<id>`): the QR (drawn in
  the browser by `/public/vendor-qrcode.js`, qrcode-generator 1.4.4, MIT, our own copy) with Download the QR, the dishes with Change status (a move and
  its reason), Add a dish, What the public sees, the certificate form, the history.
- **The public pages** (`certified.html`, `noindex` until launch, not in the sitemap; copied from the listing page's hero, info bar and two columns):
  `/certified/<code>` (rewrite in `vercel.json`) is the QR status page: the stamp line "Plant-Based Dish, Pre-Vegan Certified", N of M, what else they
  serve beside it, each dish Certified or Suspended, Read before you order, What the stamp means (never a health, allergen or food-safety claim),
  Something wrong? (the Feedback window, the diner report until its own form is built), checked live with the time. `/certified` is the registry.
- **Proven 2026-11-06** in a rolled-back transaction (every move and refusal above, the public read with no reason leaking, expiry, the record locks)
  and live (public actions, the team actions refuse no token). Pages checked at 1440 and 390 px beside the listing page and the Watchlist against
  mocked answers. **Not proven**: a real certificate made through the Depot (it cannot be deleted, so the first real one should be a pilot restaurant).

## Pre-Vegan Certification: the paid model (LOCKED by Sean 2026-11-06, playbook `vegans-explore-initiative-business-certification`)

Sean: "No, we're not doing free anything... This is real work... it pays for itself"; "lock it with my notes". Canon
`canon-ve-pre-vegan-certification` v8 (`paid_model_v8`), playbook decision 49755c18 and WORK QUEUE v2 13bcfd3d (replaces a194e04a for C and D).
**This replaces the free pilot in Standard V1.2.**

- **The Guide is free with its survey** (the education and the way in). **Certification is $250 per dish**, paid up front: the desk review, the
  Verifier's kitchen check, one community tasting night (feedback to the restaurant, anonymous to it, never pass or fail), the 12-month term and one
  courtesy check during it. **Renewal $150 per dish a year.** The fee buys the review, never the outcome; a failed dish may be submitted again. No free
  visits and no points for certification work.
- **The term never pauses**: a dish pulled from the menu keeps its clock running; the same unchanged dish back within the term still counts until the
  original end date.
- **Changes**: the restaurant tells us before any change to a certified dish; any change voids that dish's certification; ignorance is no excuse.
  **Hiding a change or misleading diners** ends every certification at the location and removes the restaurant from Vegans Explore (listing removed, never
  deleted) for **2 years**, then it may apply again.
- **Accountability**: every dish shows when it was last checked; secret shoppers spot check between visits (staff must say it is 100% plant-based); an
  anonymous report button on the QR page and the listing; staff kept trained.
- **Verifiers** are trained, paid-per-visit contractors, never staff. Members can train: self-paced modules, a quiz each with up to 3 tries, the 10-case ring
  test, a shadowed first visit; city by city (B7b builds the modules).
- **Starter kit included** (decal and menu marks as files); **print upgrade paid** (we redesign, print and deliver, approved before print; price after a
  printer quote). Recipes, sourcing and chef placement are separate services. The distributor pitch (Cheney Brothers, Sysco) is its own campaign.
- **Gate**: no paid application before A2 (who owns the program and the Stripe account), A4 and B6 (the attorney-reviewed agreement) and A7 (insurance).
- **The Guide gives the answers** (Sean, 2026-11-06: "we want to give them the answers... before they even decide to pay the 250, they can put those
  things into action... if all a restaurant does is takes this free guide and upgrades what they do in their kitchen and never takes the 250, I say this is
  successful"; canon v9 `guide_gives_answers_v9`). The free Pre-Vegan Restaurant Guide spells out exactly how to pass every gate (the protected cooking path,
  sourcing proof, labels, staff answers, what the Verifier checks), so a kitchen can put it in place without paying. A restaurant that only uses the Guide counts
  as a success: a traveler who will not go to a Vegan restaurant can trust one dish without asking whether the cheese is dairy or the pho has fish sauce. The $250
  buys our independent check and the public mark, never the knowledge. Measure Guide adoption on its own (readiness answers moving to ready), not only paid
  certifications.
- **Drafts rewritten 2026-11-06** on `claude/blissful-fermi-qmyiwt`: B6 (fees, term, change and deception clauses, tasting night, Schedule G), B7 (contractor,
  plain-words Form A, the Supermarket Guide scanner as a storeroom check, courtesy checks and secret shoppers, the member training path), C2 (a $250 invitation
  pointing to the free Guide), and the test menu (v2: starters and mains, 2 of 8 marked; `docs/certification/b5-art-sheet.png` redrawn). An SVG shown as an
  `<img>` cannot load the seal files it references, so the art sheet is rendered with them inlined as data URIs.

## The Supermarket Guide and its sponsorship (LOCKED by Sean 2026-11-01, playbook `ve-supermarket-guide`)

Concept session with V, locked by Sean: "lock it, go with your defaults" (canon `canon-ve-supermarket-guide`; migration
`20261101_supermarket_guide_canon.sql`). **Built 2026-11-01; prelaunch, members only** (below). Sean: "a doorway where the community will always know where to find these
vegan items on the shelves... We get a sponsor, the guide is free, as long as the sponsorship is active... this is a CPG play as well...
they're buying their spot in this massive campaign that starts in Q1."

- **The Guide** (the Dairy Guide's pattern): pick your store and find its Vegan items aisle by aisle; custom shopping lists; the produce
  section (what to buy and why); snack breakdowns; CPG products spotlighted with where to find them; each sponsor's weekly Vegan specials
  (also in the Daily Pulse). **Free while at least one supermarket sponsorship is active**, else $11 or 1,100 points.
- **Stores and the locator**: each chain keeps its one Directory listing (Grocery stores and Vegan aisles, below); each store is a row under
  it (address, pin, chapter), never its own listing; the chain's page gets **Find a store near you**, and its chapters
  (`listings.communities`) come from its real store addresses. Each store carries its own aisle map, started from what the store gives us.
- **Members index the shelves** the way the venue Guides do: confirm or update an item with a photo and an in-store location check, points
  only once approved, first to confirm earns the bounty, later ones a little less.
- **Sponsorship, quarterly from Q1 2027**: **Title Sponsor** $7,500 (one at a time; "brought to you by" on the Guide, every ad, festival
  card and booth and the Daily Pulse; their stores first; their Partner package included; first right to renew); **Supermarket Partner**
  $1,500 a chain ($750 for 3 chapters or fewer: store locator, member-indexed aisle maps, weekly specials in their chapters, ads on their
  store pages, a monthly report); **Product Spotlight** $500 a CPG product line (in the Guide and its shopping lists, where to find it in
  partner stores, one ad rail spot; stacks on the $111 Brand Partner plan); ad slots on the Guide's pages included, sold alone later.
  **Front Row Start**: sign before January 1, 2027, the rest of 2026 is promotion at no charge, first charge in January; the first three
  Supermarket Partners keep their price through 2027.
- **What they buy is the campaign and the 2027 story** (Sean: "it's an opportunity to let them know what we are gearing up to do in
  2027... Simply by appearing on our website they will be able to benefit from all of our promotion"): the Q1 2027 campaign (paid ads,
  festivals and local events with QR cards, social, the Daily Pulse) plus 2027: new markets, a growing social presence, event partnerships,
  the growing Directory, the content creator network and a campaign every quarter. Stated as plans; real numbers reported (221 real
  visitors in October 2026); every sponsored spot labeled Sponsored.
- **First**: Publix for Title Sponsor (five of our chapters, Florida first), then Whole Foods and Sprouts as Supermarket Partners.
- **Built 2026-11-01, not launched** (Sean: "hand it to Logan, build it"; migration `20261101_supermarket_guide.sql`, run through the
  one-time `ve-once-supermarket`). It runs on the venue Guides' engine, `ve-venues` (`GUIDES` `supermarket-guide`: kind `supermarket`): a
  store is a `ve_venues` row of kind `supermarket` with `chain_listing_id` (its chain's one listing), its departments are spots
  (Refrigerated, Frozen, Pantry, Snacks) and its 15 Vegan sections items, each "Aisle not mapped yet" until a member maps it with the same
  reports, photo and in-store location check, review, points and first-to-confirm bounties as the venue Guides
  (`ve_supermarket_seed_store(venue)` gives a new store the template). **Free while sponsored**: `ve_supermarket_sponsors` (tier title |
  partner | spotlight, status pending | active | ended, dates; RLS on, no policies) and its trigger run `ve_supermarket_guide_sync()`, which
  sets `ve_guides.access_rule` of `supermarket-guide` to `free` while a Title or Partner sponsorship is active, else `points`; `ve-venues`
  opens everything (reports too) when the rule is free. Stores came from Google Places: 248 Publix in South Florida (245) and Central
  Florida (3) on 2026-11-01, the import cut short by Google's rate limit. North Florida's 121 went in 2026-11-01 (`import_publix&hub=<chapter>&part=N&of=M` in `scripts/supabase-once/supermarket-import.ts`: one chapter a run, three workers, a retry on 429, three pages a city, a big chapter split into parts to stay under the gateway's 150 s; safe to run again). **Google allows 500 text searches a day for the whole project** (`SearchTextRequest per day`, resets midnight Pacific), shared with the essentials pass, audits, the backlog check and Add a listing; a run cut off by the gateway keeps searching and still spends it. Central Florida's went in 2026-11-02 in three parts (84 searches, metered as `once:publix-import`), so the preview holds **731 Publix stores**: South Florida 245, Central Florida 365, North Florida 121; `ve-once-supermarket` is the 410 stub again. **Publix is the example, nothing more** (Sean, 2026-11-01: "Let's just do Publix as an example and do the rest once a supermarket sponsors. Part of the sponsorship will cover the crawl"; canon v2): Publix in South, North and Central Florida only, to show supermarkets what the Guide looks like; no other chain and no more Publix areas are imported until a sponsorship pays for the crawl. Publix is the first sponsor we approach. **The preview, and stores stay** (Sean, 2026-11-01; canon v3): Publix in a few Florida chapters is the free preview, the way each Guide
features one item free, so every chain sees how it will look. A chain that sponsors keeps its stores in the Guide after the sponsorship ends;
the sponsorship pays for adding its stores (the crawl) and for the bounties we run on them (specials hunts, in-store content, aisle mapping, bigger
rewards). Without a sponsorship updates are organic and earn smaller incentives (not built yet: supermarket report points by sponsorship). The pitch
page says it: slides The preview and With a sponsor (`business/supermarkets.html`).
  The free example is Publix at Brickell Village (`publix-miami-cjalb8`). Page `guides/supermarket-guide.html` and
  `guide-scripts/supermarket-guide.js` (the Airport Guide's layout, `noindex`, Pascal on the right, his lines as text): Overview, **Stores**
  (supermarket, chapter and search, **Near me** by distance, 24 at a time), one store per view (`#/store/<slug>`: its departments and
  sections, Update, Add to my list; each department wears a flat line icon in a rounded square, `DEPT_ICON`, and each section a square photo, `SEC_IMG`, `public/guides/supermarket/<key>.jpg`, illustrative product shots made in Higgsfield 2026-11-01 with no labels, one surface and light, replaced by a member's accepted photo, `photo_url`; Sean: "icons... square rounded corners... thumbnails with photos of those items"). **The store page is three-fourths and one-fourth** (Sean, 2026-11-01: "3/4 with two section next to each other and then for
  the 1/4... advertising reserved for our sponsors... Humble Cabbage and a complimentary Guide"): the departments two across (one under
  1100 px) beside the ad rail (`ve-ad-rail.js` page `/guides/supermarket-guide`, slots `ve-supermarket-guide-1`, the Dairy Guide's house

  check allows only stadium, arena, airport and supermarket today), each restaurant a spot with a pin, each dish an item labelled Vegan, Vegan on request or
  Ask before you order, with a source and a last-confirmed date. Reports, first-to-confirm bounties and the 35-day stale rule are reused. Copy

  restaurant in feet and miles, straight line times about 1.3 and labelled "about N on foot", never turn-by-turn. The location-check radius is set per park
  from the farthest pin plus 100 m (`radius_m` accepts 50 to 5000; guesses: Magic Kingdom about 700 m, EPCOT about 1,000 m).

## Grocery stores and Vegan aisles (Sean, 2026-10-08)

"As we're bringing different products into these guides, it should automatically map to a supermarket
that carries them, and that supermarket should then show that product." Each supermarket is a Directory
listing (category Markets, tag `ve-grocery-store`, "Grocery store" on its card) whose page opens on a
**Vegan aisle**: every Guide product mapped to it, grouped by type, `?product=<id>` picks one out.

- Data (migration `20261008_ve_grocery_stores.sql`): `ve_products` (brand listing + product type),
  `ve_product_stores` (store carries product; `removed_at` when a Guide stops naming it, never deleted),
  `ve_store_aliases` (how a Guide writes the store: "Kroger family", "HEB"), `ve_guide_product_sources`
  (which `listings.details` key holds a Guide's products; Dairy is `dairy_guide`).
- It fills itself: a trigger on `listings.details` runs `ve_products_sync()`, and a new alias re-maps
  everything. A new Guide with products is one `ve_guide_product_sources` row; a new store is a listing plus
  its aliases. In a Guide, a store named in a product's "where" text links to its aisle inside the Guide.
- Buy link, best first: an affiliate deal (`affiliate_link_code`, a `/go/` tracked link), the product's own
  page at that store (`buy_url`), the store's search (`details.store.search_url`, used only when
  `search_checked` is `results` or `loads`; most chains block automated checks and say `blocked` until
  someone confirms the search in a browser), then the store's website.
- **A chain shows only in the chapters where it has stores** (Sean, 2026-11-01: "we have Atlanta and there's like 20 different markets

  reader) and **No menu online** (`menu_none`: `details.menu_none_ok` and a team note; it leaves the list). A Menu link saved there
  re-queues both readers, and the reader starts from it. The Menu tab says "From their website, checked <month>" for an imported menu. 168 queued on 2026-10-24.
- **Restaurant essentials** (Sean, 2026-10-25: "just because it's vegan doesn't tell the whole story... all the restaurant listings
  have, 250 character about us... the hours... the socials... the address that you can click and go to Google Maps... and then
  the menus... media... can come later once they become members"; migration `20261025_restaurant_essentials.sql`). Food places
  carry **what kind of food** (`listings.cuisines`, up to four: American & comfort food, Soul food, Caribbean... Global mix for a
  place that is not one thing; the list is `CUISINES` in `ve-listing-admin.js`, `ve-region-directory.js`, `ve-claims` and the
  table check, change all four), set in the listing editor, shown as badges beside how Vegan it is, and a Food filter on
  Restaurants, Food Trucks and Catering in the Directory. The address on every listing opens Google Maps (`mapsUrl`: their
  Google place when we hold `google_place_id`). `ve_restaurant_essentials` lists every open food place and what it lacks (about
  of 150 characters or more, hours, socials, street, menu, cuisine). Filled from what the business publishes, never invented,
  only into empty fields and never over an owner's own words, each change a `ve_listing_edits` row the Depot can undo:
  `ve-restaurant-audit` `essentials` (cron `ve-listing-essentials`, 8 AM UTC) takes hours, street, place and website from Google
  and the socials their home page links to; the Background writer (dispatcher source `listing_essentials`) writes the about (up
  to 250 characters) and the cuisines from their own site through `ve_listing_essentials_save`; menus come from `menu_import`.
- **The partner's home** (Sean, 2026-10-09: "once they're in... their dashboard is essentially their page"). When the
  signed-in visitor holds the listing's Brand Partner membership (Front Row Start's trial counts) or owns it (`ve-claims`
  `partner_status`), For <Brand> becomes **Getting Started**: Maya's onboarding tour, six slides with clips in
  `brand_door.start_tour` (welcome to the front row and where things stand; this page is your home; game days, the Dolphins
  model: five or six brands sampling with fans, coupons, content before, the community watch party and tailgate, packaged
  for the next one; the Plant-Based Showcase at events that are not Vegan, college games, festivals, tours like Warped Tour
  being explored; why we do it, Sean's words; next steps), with a Dashboard pill (full once Sean approves the claim). New
  tabs: **Opportunities** (`OPPS` in `loadBrandSite`, every card Coming; I'm interested writes `ve_initiative_interest`,
  `sponsor_tier`, tags `brand-partner` and the slug, emails the account manager; shows on `/dashboard/leads`), **Media**
  (uploads to the private `brand-partner-media` bucket through one-object signed URLs, rows in `ve_brand_media`, migration
  `20261009_ve_brand_media.sql`; the account manager is emailed each file), **Ask Maya** (free saved answers from
  `ve-auth` `guide_ask`; with none, `ve-claims` `partner_ask` emails the question to the account manager,
  `listings.details.brand_door.account_manager_email`, else Sean, Reply-To the brand, logged as `sent_to_person`), and
  **Ad console** (Coming). `?partner=preview` shows the partner's home to anyone, labelled; its buttons work only for a real
  partner or a super admin. A super admin sees the offer by default. Checkout for a brand returns to
  `/directory/<slug>?tab=brand&welcome=1`; approving a brand's claim emails them that the dashboard is open; the claim form
  skips the restaurant questions for a brand.
- A product (`/public/ve-product-view.js`): the photo with its versions (`ve_products.variants`) as round thumbnails
  under it, the chosen version's name, the brand's own description and ingredients, certifications, its Nutrition
  Facts (each version's own, cited; `ve_products.nutrition` only from a cited source such as USDA FoodData Central),
  the USDA record in full, also per version (`variants[].fdc`, else `ve_products.fdc` for the first; from
  `fdc.nal.usda.gov/portal-data/external/<id>`, found with a POST to `/portal-data/external/search`, both of which work
  when the api.nal.usda.gov DEMO_KEY is rate limited; a version with no record says so), Where to find it (each store a button, logo and name, to its Vegan aisle
  on Vegans Explore; never the store's own site: "we want to keep them in our environment"), and more from the brand.
  `/products/<slug>` (`directory/product.html`, rewrite in `vercel.json`) is the shareable link and forwards to the
  brand page with that product open. In a Guide it opens as `#/product/<slug>`. Shared helpers: `/public/ve-products.js`.
- Pictures: product photos are copied into `vegan-media/media/products/<slug>/` from the brand's own product page and
  Open Food Facts (credit CC BY-SA); Sean, 2026-10-08: brand photos are fine to use, and we reach out to the brand.
  Store and brand logos are copied into `vegan-media/media/logos/` (`listings.logo_url`), each checked by eye. Videos
  are the brand's own uploads, checked through YouTube oEmbed (`author_url`). The edge function `ve-off-lookup` (admin
  token) looks at and copies pictures; it writes no rows.
- A new listing gets `vegan_status = 'fully_vegan'` by default. Set it on purpose (null for a store, which is
  not a Vegan business), or the Directory calls it 100% Vegan.
- Next: the sponsorship offer to a store (its page with deals for our members). Amazon Associates is set (`vegansexplore-20`,
  2026-10-29): a product's Amazon link made as a `/go/` link carries it.

## Dashboard versions (Sean, 2026-10-24; built 2026-10-25)

"The dashboard could actually be the main dashboard, and then we have different versions of it. So if they're a coach...
if they're a pre-vegan, the dashboard set up a certain way." One `/dashboard` with four versions: **Business**, **Just
starting** (`pre_vegan`), **Coach or pro** (`coach`) and **Member**. **The survey picks it, not a dropdown** (Sean, 2026-10-28: "I
don't get the drop down... we should know who they are... using a survey to figure out how to tailor this experience for them...
a detailed survey where they can get 250 points... They could save it and come back to it"; migration
`20261028_member_survey_drafts.sql`): the version switch is gone and `members.dashboard_version` is no longer read (`ve-dashboard`
`home` returns `ve_dashboard_version()` and `survey {completed, at, active}`). **Your survey** is the Mission Survey on its own page,
`/dashboard/survey` (`survey.html`, `openSurvey`), the first For you tile until it is done. **It is the member's profile, built like a
dating profile** (Sean, the same day: "treat it like a dating profile where it asks different questions about themselves that will be
added to their profile... a combined 250 points for every question they answer with some questions being worth more than others";
migration `20261028_member_profile_points.sql`): **Your profile** (`VEMissionSurvey.profile`) shows every question as a card, answered
in any order, one question per view (`#q/<id>`, Save and next, Save, Back to your profile), with points earned out of 250 and Answer
the next one. 31 questions: **In your words** (`p_meal`, `p_why`, `p_day`, `p_meet`, `p_fact`, 300 characters, 15 points each) and
the old survey's, now none required; the ones marked `team` (market research) sit under **Help us build your city**, "for the team,
not your profile". The points live in `ve_profile_questions()` (`PTS` in the script only draws them); `ve_profile_answer` saves each
answer the moment it is given (`members.mission_survey_answers` and the columns it maps to) and pays it once (`ve_points_grant`,
reason `profile_answer`, ref `profile:<question>`), never again on a change; complete (`mission_survey_completed_at`) means all 250
earned. `ve-mission-survey` `profile`, `answer`, `save` (`draft`, `draft_save` and `submit` still work). The Guide's setup asks the
same questions one after another (`VEMissionSurvey.mount`, each Next saves and pays that answer, Save and finish later moves the setup
on). The For you tile reads Build your profile / Keep building your profile with the points left (`ve-dashboard` `survey {earned,
total}`). The old survey's 250 had never paid anyone (`award_points_bounty` had no `mission_survey_completed` rule); its two finishers
were paid for their answers by the migration. No other member sees a profile yet. **What matters to you** (q23 to q26) counts Health or
medicine and Coaching or fitness as Coach or pro. `ve-mission-survey` is in the repo since 2026-10-28.
**Your numbers** (Sean, 2026-10-28: "under your role, it says platform health... For the members... what are the three things that
they're going to want to see... their points and their level. And if they're an ambassador, their... commissions"): every member but a
super admin gets three tiles on the Dashboard tab, Your points, Your level (points to the next) and, for an Ambassador, **Earned in
<year>** (this year's commissions but refunds, from `ve-affiliate` `me`), else Joined with your link (`renderMyNumbers`; each opens
Points and levels). Your Role (Platform Health) stays for super admins, Today's Pulse for Community Managers. A version decides only which cards join For you
(`renderVersion` in `dashboard/center-console.html`) and the order of Your tools (`DASH_TOOLS_FIRST`); everything else is
shared.

**Every tab wears the city banner** (Sean, 2026-10-27: "the dashboard and the depot and my saves... and even guides... should have
the same header as events directory... when you expand it to see something there, even if we still use just the city that's
selected"): the Dashboard (Welcome back, <name>; it replaced the welcome row), Guides, My Saves and the Depot join Directory, Events,

2026-10-31; a filter picked by hand stays for the visit); a row opens the request in a window (who, chapter,

**Recent activity** has the **Leaderboard** as one of its boxes, the same size (it stays beside For you for everyone else), and every

## Your Guide (Sean, 2026-10-04)

Your Guide is for registered members, inside the dashboard window: `/dashboard/guide` opens `/guide`
under "Dashboard / Your Guide" (`openGuide` in center-console; `/guide` opened on its own moves there
when signed in and shows a sign-in gate when signed out). Opened from the **Set up your Guide** action
item (first in Action items until done), the dock's Guide icon, and the Choose Your Guide tile.

- Setup: 1. meet your Guide (Passport members choose from six; everyone else has Liz, and choosing is a
  Passport benefit, enforced in `ve-guide`), 2. the Guide asks the Mission Survey if they have not taken
  it (`/public/ve-mission-survey.js`, the only copy of the questions; 250 points via ve-mission-survey),
  3. how the Guide helps (restaurants, things to do in their city, finding something, anything Vegan),
  each idea a question they can send. Then the dock icon opens the conversation.
- Survey screen (Sean, 2026-10-05): one question at a time with one button. A tap only marks an answer,
  Next moves on and skips an optional question left blank (no auto-advance, no Skip). "Vegan" is always
  capitalized in the questions. Question 7 is Month and Year lists, sent as YYYY-MM. The last screen puts
  the four ideas two by two on the left and the Guide's portrait (mid shot) on the right.
- Data: `ve-guide` edge function (`status`, `setup`), `members.guide_slug` and `members.guide_setup_at`.
  The dock icon wears the Guide from `ve_guide_flow_state` (`/public/footer.js`), kept in step from
  `ve-guide` status.
- Quick answers first (Sean, 2026-10-06, see Guide answers below): a question goes to `ve-auth`
  `guide_ask` (free, no AI). With no saved answer the member chooses "Ask <Guide> directly (4 points)".
- Chat: `ve-auth` `guide_chat_send`, members only, 4 points a message from a monthly allowance (60
  points, 300 with Passport). "Send us a message" in the conversation opens the old question box (a
  person answers by email) through the dashboard (`ve-open-help`).
- Not yet: the Guide's replies do not read the member's survey answers. That needs the shared reply
  engine (`character-respond`, used across LESARUSS) to take member context.
- Depot > Preview journeys > Your Guide walks every screen (`/guide?preview=<step>`, `PREVIEWS` in
  `guide.html`); a new screen gets a preview there and a line in `JOURNEYS.guide`.

"A LESARUSS button... like how you do Google... log in here and you immediately get access to any of our communities... at the
passport rate, your passport works... you still got to pay the $11 to get into the other communities." One LESARUSS account signs in
on every brand (migration `20261029_lesaruss_sign_in.sql`, edge function `ve-lesaruss-sso`, HQ `app/connect` and `lib/sso.ts` in
lesaruss/lesaruss-hq).

- **The button is off** (Sean, 2026-10-29: "it just took me to another place where I would have to choose Apple or Google... why
  don't I just use the Google to log in?... let's not push it out to anywhere else... log in the same way and we will pick up on your
  membership"). In its place the sign-in window and `/login` say "Already a LESARUSS member? Sign in with the same Google account or
  email, and we pick up your membership" (`LESARUSS_NOTE` in `public/ve-auth.js`): one email is one account, so Google or a password
  signs in the same account, and a Diplomat comes in through `ve_member_entitled`. The privacy paragraph says the same (2026-10-29).
- **The quiet check** (Sean, 2026-10-29: "If they have an active login session on... their browser... it should pick up on that";
  "build the session pickup"). When someone goes to sign in (`/login`, or the sign-in window opened with no follow-up waiting,
  `showAuthModal` without a callback), `quietPickup` in `public/ve-auth.js` hops the browser once to HQ's `/connect/silent` (lesaruss-hq
  `app/connect/silent/route.ts`): signed in on hq.lesaruss.ai, it comes straight back with a one-time code and `/auth/lesaruss` signs
  them in here (the same code, `ve-lesaruss-sso` and Passport rule as below); signed out, it comes straight back with
  `error=login_required` and the page shows its usual sign-in (`?ve_signin=login|signup` reopens the window, then leaves the address).
  Nothing to see or click either way. Once a tab session (`sessionStorage` `ve_lesaruss_quiet`), vegansexplore.com and its previews
  only, never in a frame, on a brand page (`VE_BRAND`) or for anyone holding a token. HQ answers only return addresses on
  `lesaruss_sso_clients`, anything else a plain 400.
- **The button** sat under Continue with Google in the sign-in window and on `/login` (`LESARUSS_BTN`, `loginWithLesaruss` in
  `public/ve-auth.js`; any element with `data-ve-lesaruss="<path to come back to>"` starts it). It keeps a random state in the tab and
  opens `hq.lesaruss.ai/connect?client=vegans-explore&redirect_uri=<origin>/auth/lesaruss&state=` (a preview of this site uses the
  HQ branch preview, `LESARUSS_HQ`). HQ signs them in, shows who they are and what they get, and on Continue sends back a one-time
  code (kept only as its sha256 in `lesaruss_sso_codes`, two minutes, once; the return address must be on `lesaruss_sso_clients`
  exactly or match its preview pattern).
- **`/auth/lesaruss`** (`auth/lesaruss.html`, `noindex`) checks the state and trades the code (`VEAuth.finishLesaruss`,
  `ve-lesaruss-sso`): a session like ve-auth's. **One email is one `members` row across every brand**
  (`idx_members_email_unique_global`), so the row may be their LESARUSS.ai one: a **Diplomat** (`lesaruss_is_diplomat`, the $111
  membership) is let in as they are; **another brand's account that is not a Diplomat is refused** (`passport_needed`: Get your
  Passport or Become a Diplomat), since its status is that brand's (17 free LESARUSS.ai accounts read as active); a Vegans Explore
  account signs in as it is (waiting for its Passport, the $11 window opens); an email with no account gets one waiting for its
  Passport. Super admins pass.
- **Brand memberships** (Sean, 2026-10-29: "GO"; migration `20261029_brand_memberships.sql`). `brand_memberships` records who holds
  what on which brand: `vegans-explore` passport (paid) or comp (on us), `lesaruss-ai` diplomat. `ve_member_entitled(member)` is
  whether a row's status counts here: a Vegans Explore account (its status is ours, unchanged), a Vegans Explore Passport or comp on
  record, a Diplomat, or a super admin. Every sign-in (`ve-auth` login and both Google paths, `ve-lesaruss-sso`) refuses another
  brand's account that is not entitled with `passport_needed` and an $11 checkout the server makes (`passportNeeded`; no session
  token reaches the browser); the $11 window's button goes there (`_passportNeeded` in `public/ve-auth.js`), and payment returns to
  `/login?passport=paid` to sign in again. `ve-auth` `me` reads such an account as `pending_payment`, so an older session drops to
  the $11 window. Vegans Explore accounts are recorded by trigger (`trg_ve_brand_membership_sync`); another brand's account gets its
  Passport through `ve_brand_membership_grant` (the webhook's `entry_contribution`, the test checkout, `ve_member_admit`, which now
  returns true when it made them a member here), and the webhook's welcome points go to it as a first join. The Diplomat rows follow
  `ve_diplomat_sync`. On 2026-10-29 all 24 active Vegans Explore accounts, the switch accounts, Sean and the two Diplomats stayed in;
  the 16 free LESARUSS accounts (seed, test and internal ones) are refused here.
- `members.diplomat_since` and `ve_diplomat_sync()` (cron `ve-diplomat-sync`, daily) are ready for an account ever made active here
  for being a Diplomat; nothing sets it today.
- `/policies#privacy` says it (One LESARUSS account). Children's brands are never clients.

## Guide answers: a free knowledge base in front of the Guides (Sean, 2026-10-06)

"Make it more like a chat bot where it's essentially a knowledge base... once it has it, it should
immediately pick up and pull into a database of potential questions and answers... not paying out of
pocket for anything." Most questions repeat, so most answers cost nothing.

- `guide_kb_answers`: saved answers (`live` are served, `draft` wait for a check, `needs_sean` are
  questions only Sean can answer, saved for a session with him, `retired`). One row per question, with
  `also_asked` paraphrases, one link, a topic, and `featured` for the chips under the chat.
- `guide_kb_questions`: every question, what it matched, and what happened (`answered` free,
  `no_match`, `sent_to_guide` with the AI reply, `guide_failed`). View `guide_kb_gaps` is the to-do
  list: unanswered questions, most asked first, with the latest AI reply as a starting point.
- `guide_kb_match()`: Postgres text search plus trigram similarity, zero tokens. `ve-auth` `guide_ask`
  answers at a score of 0.42 or more and offers related questions at 0.22 or more; `guide_topics`
  gives the featured chips. Anyone can ask (free); the AI Guide is members only.
- Growing it: an AI Guide reply is saved as a `draft` answer automatically. Logan writes answers he can
  source from the site and canon; anything else goes to `needs_sean` for a question session with Sean.
  A draft goes live only after a check, so a wrong AI answer is never served as fact.
- Facts must agree with `ve-guide-platform-facts` (what the AI Guides know). Change both together.
- Ask a person (Sean, 2026-10-06): "if we aren't getting the answers, they can reach out to either the
  CM or myself." Next to every answer and every miss, Ask a person (`ve-auth` `guide_ask_person`,
  members, five a day) emails the question to contact@lesaruss.com and to the member's city Community
  Manager (`members.ve_role = 'community_manager'`, same `home_community`), Reply-To the member. Logged
  as `sent_to_person`, so it stays on `guide_kb_gaps` until it has a saved answer. Members only ever
  see "the team", never Sean's name or the Community Manager (Sean, 2026-10-06).
- Conversation memory (Sean, 2026-10-06: warn them near the limit and prompt a new one): the Guide
  remembers the latest 20 messages of a conversation. `guide_chat_send` returns `memory {used, max}`;
  from 16 the chat warns and offers Start a new conversation (a new `conversation` id, its own room).
  Under 3 messages of allowance left, it says so; quick answers and Ask a person stay free.
- Low on points (Sean, 2026-10-25, replacing the 2026-10-06 Add points top-up): money no longer buys points, so
  when points run low the chat offers See the Bounties and the Board (`topUpBox` in `guide.html`), opened in the
  whole window. Points are never bought (Sean locked 2026-10-25); Guides are $11 or 1,100 points.
- Migration `20261006_guide_kb.sql`. Brand-ready (`brand_slug`), so other brands can reuse it.

## Search and share previews, built in (Sean, 2026-10-30)

"When we're building stuff, we're doing it for search and discoverability... not doing it after." Every page that should be found
ships with them on the first pass, never as a later fix:

- **In the HTML the server sends**, not only set by JavaScript: a real `<title>` ("Name — Vegans Explore"), a `meta description`
  (about 150 characters, what the page is), `<link rel="canonical">`, `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image` (1200 x 630; the
  fallback is `/public/og-default.jpg`, never a file that does not exist) and `twitter:card`. Link previews (Facebook, iMessage,
  Slack) never run JavaScript.
- **A page built from the database** gets a server function that writes them in, like `api/event.js` (every
  `/events?event=<id>`, sent there by `middleware.js` since the static page wins over a `vercel.json` rewrite: the event's title, schema.org Event with status, place, organizer and
  offer, and the event itself as plain HTML inside `#ev-cal`, which `ve-events.js` replaces; 2026-11-02), `api/listing.js` (every
  `/directory/<slug>`, with schema.org data: Restaurant, LocalBusiness, Organization, Person, PodcastSeries, Book, Movie) and
  `api/pulse-article.js` (`/pulse/<slug>`). Change `api/listing.js` with the SEO block in `directory/listing.html` (search "SEO:
  title, OG tags"): both use the same title, the city only for a local business.
- **The sitemap is live**: `/sitemap.xml` is `api/sitemap.js` (the main pages, every chapter, every live Guide, every approved
  listing, every published Pulse article, every live event from the last year on). A new page to be found goes in its `PAGES` or `GUIDES`, a new chapter in `CHAPTERS`.
  Never link a redirect from it.
- Pages that should not be found (samples, Depot, account, welcome Guides for invitees) carry `noindex` and stay out of the sitemap.

## Pictures and page weight (Sean, 2026-10-31)

"The site overall just feels very sluggish." The Rich Roll page flickered on phones and drew only its first episode: every
episode thumbnail was the show's own art at full size (up to 3000 x 3000, 0.1 to 3.9 MB each, 20 a page), and iPhone Safari ran out
of picture memory. The homepage was 8.2 MB, mostly city banners. Rules from that day:

- **Pictures from other sites go through Vercel's resizer**: `/_vercel/image?url=<encoded>&w=<width>&q=75` (`images` in
  `vercel.json`: `sizes` lists the allowed widths, `remotePatterns` the allowed hosts, cached 31 days). An `<img>` with
  `loading="lazy"`, `decoding="async"`, width and height, and an `onerror` that falls back to the original link (`small` and `img` in
  `public/ve-episodes.js`). Ask for about twice the size shown. A new podcast host is a `remotePatterns` row; until then its art falls
  back to full size. Never open the resizer to every host (anyone could run their pictures through our bill).
- **Pictures in the repo are sized before they are committed**: a photo is a JPEG (never a PNG unless it needs transparency), at most
  1920 px wide for a landscape hero, 1440 px for a portrait one, about 900 x 1200 for a Guide portrait, quality about 80. A city banner
  should be under about 500 KB. On 2026-10-31 the Guide portraits (5 MB PNGs) became 100-165 KB JPEGs and the Philadelphia and D.C.
  banners JPEGs; the old PNGs stay for outside links.
- **A listing opened from the dashboard on a phone is its own page** (Sean, 2026-10-31: "it keeps restarting... it locks the whole
  thing, so I can't even click the menu"). `/dashboard/directory/<slug>` frames the listing on desktop only; at 760 px and under,
  `openDashboardListing` (and a script at the top of `center-console.html`, before the dashboard loads) goes to `/directory/<slug>`.
  Framed on a phone, the listing was a fixed 1800 px box that took every swipe (the listing marks itself `ve-embedded`, so `nav.js`
  never sizes its frame) and the phone held the dashboard and the listing page at once, so Safari dropped the frame and reloaded it.
- Not done yet: the homepage loads every chapter's banner at once; `directory/listing.html` loads ten scripts in order before the page
  shows, the admin editor and business dashboard scripts included for visitors.

## Video pace: a new shot every 3 seconds (Sean, 2026-11-08, canon `canon-video-shot-pace`)

"People's attention spans are way too short to be sitting there watching a page scroll choppily for 6 seconds." In every narrated video we
make (tours, Guide and page videos, social, ads, the podcast's video), the shot changes about every 3 seconds (never more than about 3.5), each
shot a still with a slow, smooth zoom or gentle pan, never a scrolling page. Capture pages as viewport-sized stills, cut on the words with stt
timings, render the zoom smoothly (no stair-stepping), and send Sean a short sample before the full render.

Captivate (`analytics_connections` `captivate`, `VE_CAPTIVATE_API_KEY`; show in `PODCAST_SHOWS`). **What Captivate's API gives**, probed
